description.value: You've learned to make one clean bandage roll do the work of three. When you Treat Wounds using scavenged (rather than store-bought) healer's tools, you don't take the normal penalty for using an improvised healer's toolkit.

cinderfall.incomplete: No rule-element key models a penalty for using improvised/scavenged tools on Treat Wounds, so there is nothing to remove.
